text: The man has been in here 50 years, Heywood. 50 years. This is all he knows. In here, he's an important man. He's an educated man. Outside, he's nothing.
author: Ellis Boyd "Red" Redding
visual_brief: An architectural cross-section of an abandoned Victorian greenhouse enclosing a single massive, ancient tree whose upper branches have slowly pressed through and shattered the iron-framed glass roof. Clean white drafting lines detail the rusted trusses, fallen panes, and delicate dimensional callouts measuring the constricted space.
alt: Architectural drawing of an overgrown tree breaking through a greenhouse roof
